all.source_quote: Age should be between18 and 40 years at the time of enrollment.
Monthly income should be Rs 15,000 or less.

unmodelled.text: Must be an unorganized sector worker (e.g., street vendors, construction workers, domestic workers, etc.)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be an unorganized sector worker (e.g., street vendors, construction workers, domestic workers, etc.).

unmodelled.text: Must possess a valid Aadhaar number linked with a mobile number

unmodelled.text: Should have an active savings bank account or Jan Dhan account
unmodelled.source_quote: Should have anactive savings bank account or Jan Ohan account.
